title: Roof Maintenance in Portland, OR
summary: In January 2026, French Roofing did general maintenance on a low-slope membrane roof on a home in Portland, OR. The crew cleared leaves and debris off the roof and rinsed the membrane down with a hose, leaving the surface around the chimney, vents and skylights clear.
scope: Cleared leaves and debris off the low-slope roof
Rinsed the roof membrane down with a hose
body: Before the visit, water was sitting in a few low spots on the roof, with leaves and a film of dirt collected in it. The later photos show the same roof rinsed and clear, still drying in the sun.
